0.description: An ultrasound loop, the aorta picked out by Mask R-CNN, then one frame measured two ways: 4.43 cm with the hackathon method, 2.77 cm with the improved one. Both 3D meshes turn side by side at the end.

1.description: A question typed into the chatbot, a quiz verdict, a photo of a pad turned into a blood-volume estimate, and a week of daily totals.

2.description: A paper form stamped “pendiente”, then the agent's own log as it reads a tax certificate and returns eight fields as JSON, with a second stamp: “extraído”.
